description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLanguage entity class, which models the language skills of an employee within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties for employee, language, fluency, competency, and comments, along with associated ORM mappings and validation logic.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's language skills, including fluency, competency, and comments, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this language skill record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this language skill record.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the Language associated with this employee language record.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the Language for this employee language record.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Returns the fluency level (as an integer code) for this language skill.

methods.name: setFluency
methods.description: Sets the fluency level; throws InvalidArgumentException if the value is invalid.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Returns the competency level (if any) for this language skill.

methods.name: setCompetency
methods.description: Sets the competency level; throws InvalidArgumentException if the value is invalid.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns optional comments regarding the language skill.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets optional comments regarding the language skill.
